(minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Flattened Octree for the GPU\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DevNode {\n    float cx, cy, cz;      // center\n    float hx, hy, hz;      // half extent\n    int childStart;        // index of first child (children are contiguous, in original order)\n    int childCount;\n    int triStart;          // leaf: first entry in leaf triangle array (3 float4 per entry)\n    int triCount;          // leaf iff triCount > 0 (matches !triangleIndices.empty())\n};\n\nconstexpr int OCTREE_STACK = 128;\n\nstruct FlatOctree {\n    std::vector<DevNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<float4> leafTris;  // per entry: {a, idx bits}, {e1, 0}, {e2, 0}\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n\n    void flatten(const Octree& root, const std::vector<Triangle>& tris) {\n        nodes.clear();\n        leafTris.clear();\n        nodes.push_back(DevNode{});\n        fill(root, 0, tris, 0);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void fill(const Octree& node, size_t slot, const std::vector<Triangle>& tris, int depth) {\n        maxDepth = std::max(maxDepth, depth);\n        DevNode dn{};\n        dn.cx = node.center.x; dn.cy = node.center.y; dn.cz = node.center.z;\n        dn.hx = node.halfExtent.x; dn.hy = node.halfExtent.y; dn.hz = node.halfExtent.z;\n        dn.triStart = static_cast<int>(leafTris.size() / 3);\n        dn.triCount = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());\n        for (size_t idx : node.triangleIndices) {\n            const Triangle& t = tris[idx];\n            Vec3 e1 = t.b - t.a;\n            Vec3 e2 = t.c - t.a;\n            int ii = static_cast<int>(idx);\n            float fidx;\n            memcpy(&fidx, &ii, sizeof(float));\n            leafTris.push_back(make_float4(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z, fidx));\n            leafTris.push_back(make_float4(e1.x, e1.y, e1.z, 0.0f));\n            leafTris.push_back(make_float4(e2.x, e2.y, e2.z, 0.0f));\n        }\n        std::vector<const Octree*> kids;\n        if (node.triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)\n                if (node.children[i]) kids.push_back(node.children[i].get());\n        }\n        dn.childStart = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());\n        dn.childCount = static_cast<int>(kids.size());\n        nodes[slot] = dn;\n        size_t base = nodes.size();\n        nodes.resize(base + kids.size());\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < kids.size(); ++k) fill(*kids[k], base + k, tris, depth + 1);\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation: MT19937 with jump-ahead\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// The reference uses std::mt19937(42) with std::uniform_real_distribution<float>,\n// which consumes exactly one 32-bit draw per value: u = float(x) / 2^32 (clamped\n// below 1). A non-culled (i, j) pair consumes 64 consecutive draws in row-major\n// pair order (u, v for the point on i, then u, v for the point on j, per ray).\n\nnamespace mtj {\nconstexpr int MT_N = 624, MT_M = 397;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_A = 0x9908b0dfu, MT_UP = 0x80000000u, MT_LO = 0x7fffffffu;\nconstexpr int DEG = 19937;\nconstexpr int NW = (DEG + 63) / 64;   // 64-bit words of a reduced polynomial\n\nusing State = std::array<uint32_t, MT_N>;   // logical order: next word is f(x[0], x[1], x[397])\n\ninline uint32_t mtNext(uint32_t x0, uint32_t x1, uint32_t xm) {\n    uint32_t y = (x0 & MT_UP) | (x1 & MT_LO);\n    return xm ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_A : 0u);\n}\n\ninline State seedState(uint32_t seed) {\n    State s;\n    s[0] = seed;\n    for (int i = 1; i < MT_N; ++i) s[i] = 1812433253u * (s[i - 1] ^ (s[i - 1] >> 30)) + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);\n    return s;\n}\n\n// Raw (untempered) word sequence x_0 .. x_{len-1} starting from state s\ninline void rawSequence(const State& s, std::vector<uint32_t>& seq, size_t len) {\n    seq.resize(len);\n    for (int i = 0; i < MT_N && static_cast<size_t>(i) < len; ++i) seq[i] = s[i];\n    for (size_t n = MT_N; n < len; ++n) seq[n] = mtNext(seq[n - MT_N], seq[n - MT_N + 1], seq[n - MT_N + MT_M]);\n}\n\nstruct Poly { std::vector<uint64_t> w; };\n\nclass Field {\npublic:\n    std::vector<uint64_t> phi;                    // characteristic polynomial (DEG+1 bits)\n    std::vector<std::vector<uint64_t>> phiSh;     // phi << s for s = 0..63 (NW+1 words each)\n\n    Field() {\n        // Berlekamp-Massey on one output bit of MT19937 recovers its characteristic polynomial\n        const int len = 2 * DEG + 64;\n        std::vector<uint32_t> seq;\n        rawSequence(seedState(5489u), seq, static_cast<size_t>(len) + MT_N);\n        const int nw = (len + 64) / 64 + 2;\n        // R holds the bit stream reversed: bit k of R = s_{len-1-k}\n        std::vector<uint64_t> R(nw, 0), C(nw, 0), B(nw, 0), T;\n        for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n            uint32_t bit = seq[static_cast<size_t>(len - 1 - k) + MT_N] >> 31;\n            if (bit) R[k >> 6] |= 1ull << (k & 63);\n        }\n        C[0] = B[0] = 1;\n        int L = 0, m = 1;\n        auto getR = [&](int off, int wi) -> uint64_t {\n            int bitpos = off + 64 * wi;\n            int q = bitpos >> 6, r = bitpos & 63;\n            uint64_t lo = (q < nw) ? R[q] : 0;\n            if (r == 0) return lo;\n            uint64_t hi = (q + 1 < nw) ? R[q + 1] : 0;\n            return (lo >> r) | (hi << (64 - r));\n        };\n        auto xorShifted = [&](std::vector<uint64_t>& dst, const std::vector<uint64_t>& src, int sh, int words) {\n            int q = sh >> 6, r = sh & 63;\n            int hiw = std::min(nw - 1, words + q + 1);\n            for (int i = hiw; i >= q; --i) {\n                uint64_t v = 0;\n                if (i - q < nw) v = src[i - q] << r;\n                if (r && i - q - 1 >= 0) v |= src[i - q - 1] >> (64 - r);\n                dst[i] ^= v;\n            }\n        };\n        int lenB = 0;  // degree bound of B\n        for (int n = 0; n < len; ++n) {\n            // discrepancy d = sum_{i=0..L} C_i s_{n-i}, with s_{n-i} = bit (len-1-n+i) of R\n            int off = len - 1 - n;\n            uint64_t acc = 0;\n            int words = (L >> 6) + 1;\n            for (int wi = 0; wi < words; ++wi) {\n                uint64_t cw = C[wi];\n                if (wi == words - 1 && ((L + 1) & 63)) cw &= (1ull << ((L + 1) & 63)) - 1;\n                acc ^= cw & getR(off, wi);\n            }\n            if (!(__builtin_popcountll(acc) & 1)) { ++m; continue; }\n            if (2 * L <= n) {\n                T = C;\n                xorShifted(C, B, m, (lenB >> 6) + 1);\n                int oldL = L;\n                L = n + 1 - L;\n                B = std::move(T);\n                lenB = oldL;\n                m = 1;\n            } else {\n                xorShifted(C, B, m, (lenB >> 6) + 1);\n                ++m;\n            }\n        }\n        if (L != DEG) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MT19937 characteristic polynomial degree mismatch (%d)\\n\", L);\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        // phi(x) = x^L C(1/x): coefficient of x^(L-i) is C_i\n        phi.assign(NW + 1, 0);\n        for (int i = 0; i <= L; ++i)\n            if ((C[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1) { int e = L - i; phi[e >> 6] |= 1ull << (e & 63); }\n        phiSh.assign(64, std::vector<uint64_t>(NW + 1, 0));\n        for (int s = 0; s < 64; ++s)\n            for (int i = 0; i <= NW; ++i) {\n                uint64_t v = phi[i] << s;\n                if (s && i > 0) v |= phi[i - 1] >> (64 - s);\n                phiSh[s][i] = v;\n            }\n    }\n\n    // Reduce a polynomial modulo phi in place; result occupies the first NW words\n    void reduce(std::vector<uint64_t>& a) const {\n        for (int wi = static_cast<int>(a.size()) - 1; wi >= 0; --wi) {\n            while (true) {\n                uint64_t v = a[wi];\n                if (!v) break;\n                int b = wi * 64 + 63 - __builtin_clzll(v);\n                if (b < DEG) break;\n                int sh = b - DEG, q = sh >> 6, r = sh & 63;\n                const uint64_t* ps = phiSh[r].data();\n                int lim = std::min(NW + 1, static_cast<int>(a.size()) - q);\n                for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) a[q + i] ^= ps[i];\n            }\n            if (wi * 64 < DEG) break;\n        }\n        a.resize(NW);\n    }\n\n    static uint64_t spread32(uint32_t v) {\n        uint64_t x = v;\n        x = (x | (x << 16)) & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull;\n        x = (x | (x << 8)) & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull;\n        x = (x | (x << 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full;\n        x = (x | (x << 2)) & 0x3333333333333333ull;\n        x = (x | (x << 1)) & 0x5555555555555555ull;\n        return x;\n    }\n\n    Poly square(const Poly& p) const {\n        std::vector<uint64_t> a(2 * NW, 0);\n        for (int i = 0; i < NW; ++i) {\n            a[2 * i] = spread32(static_cast<uint32_t>(p.w[i]));\n            a[2 * i + 1] = spread32(static_cast<uint32_t>(p.w[i] >> 32));\n        }\n        reduce(a);\n        return Poly{std::move(a)};\n    }\n\n    Poly mulX(const Poly& p) const {\n        std::vector<uint64_t> a(NW + 1, 0);\n        for (int i = NW; i >= 0; --i) {\n            uint64_t v = (i < NW ? p.w[i] << 1 : 0);\n            if (i > 0) v |= p.w[i - 1] >> 63;\n            a[i] = v;\n        }\n        reduce(a);\n        return Poly{std::move(a)};\n    }\n\n    // x^n mod phi\n    Poly powX(uint64_t n) const {\n        Poly r{std::vector<uint64_t>(NW, 0)};\n        r.w[0] = 1;\n        if (n == 0) return r;\n        int hb = 63 - __builtin_clzll(n);\n        for (int b = hb; b >= 0; --b) {\n            r = square(r);\n            if ((n >> b) & 1) r = mulX(r);\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    // Advance state s by n draws, where p = x^n mod phi: result = sum_i p_i T^i s\n    static State jump(const Poly& p, const State& s) {\n        std::vector<uint32_t> seq;\n        rawSequence(s, seq, static_cast<size_t>(DEG) + MT_N);\n        State acc{};\n        for (int wi = 0; wi < NW; ++wi) {\n            uint64_t v = p.w[wi];\n            while (v) {\n                int i = wi * 64 + __builtin_ctzll(v);\n                v &= v - 1;\n                const uint32_t* src = seq.data() + i;\n                for (int k = 0; k < MT_N; ++k) acc[k] ^= src[k];\n            }\n        }\n        return acc;\n    }\n};\n} // namespace mtj\n\n// Generate tempered MT19937 output for many chunks in parallel (one block per chunk).\n// Each chunk starts from its own (jumped-ahead) state and produces chunkLen draws.\nconstexpr int MT_THREADS = 256;\n\n__global__ void mtGenerateKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ states, uint32_t* __restrict__ out,\n                                 uint64_t chunkLen) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t x[mtj::MT_N];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const uint32_t* st = states + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * mtj::MT_N;\n    for (int k = tid; k < mtj::MT_N; k += blockDim.x) x[k] = st[k];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    uint32_t* dst = out + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * chunkLen;\n    const uint64_t nBlocks = chunkLen / mtj::MT_N;\n\n    auto temper = [](uint32_t y) {\n        y ^= (y >> 11);\n        y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n        y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n        y ^= (y >> 18);\n        return y;\n    };\n    auto next = [](uint32_t x0, uint32_t x1, uint32_t xm) {\n        uint32_t y = (x0 & 0x80000000u) | (x1 & 0x7fffffffu);\n        return xm ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? 0x9908b0dfu : 0u);\n    };\n\n    for (uint64_t b = 0; b < nBlocks; ++b) {\n        uint32_t* o = dst + b * mtj::MT_N;\n        // Phase 1: k in [0, 227) uses old x[k+397]\n        uint32_t v = 0;\n        int k = tid;\n        if (k < 227) v = next(x[k], x[k + 1], x[k + 397]);\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (k < 227) { x[k] = v; o[k] = temper(v); }\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Phase 2: k in [227, 454) uses new x[k-227]\n        k = 227 + tid;\n        if (tid < 227) v = next(x[k], x[k + 1], x[k - 227]);\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid < 227) { x[k] = v; o[k] = temper(v); }\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Phase 3: k in [454, 624) uses new x[k-227]; k = 623 uses new x[0]\n        k = 454 + tid;\n        if (tid < 170) v = next(x[k], x[(k + 1) % mtj::MT_N], x[k - 227]);\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid < 170) { x[k] = v; o[k] = temper(v); }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float drawToFloat(uint32_t u) {\n    // generate_canonical<float, 24>(mt19937): float(u) / 2^32, clamped below 1\n    float r = __uint2float_rn(u) * 2.3283064365386963e-10f;\n    return (r >= 1.0f) ? 0x1.fffffep-1f : r;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                                      const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& e1, const Vec3& e2) {\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38f;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38f;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38f;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray segment intersects a node's bounding box\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(const DevNode& n, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 center(n.cx, n.cy, n.cz);\n    Vec3 halfExtent(n.hx, n.hy, n.hz);\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const DevNode* __restrict__ nodes, const float4* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                             int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n    const val_t maxDist = rayLen - EPSILON;\n\n    int stack[OCTREE_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root is visited without a box test\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const DevNode n = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (n.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int t = 0; t < n.triCount; ++t) {\n                const float4* e = leafTris + 3 * static_cast<size_t>(n.triStart + t);\n                float4 a = __ldg(e);\n                int idx = __float_as_int(a.w);\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                float4 b = __ldg(e + 1);\n                float4 c = __ldg(e + 2);\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, Vec3(a.x, a.y, a.z),\n                                                  Vec3(b.x, b.y, b.z), Vec3(c.x, c.y, c.z));\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < maxDist) return true;  // Ray is blocked\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int k = n.childCount - 1; k >= 0; --k) {\n                int ci = n.childStart + k;\n                if (rayIntersectsBox(nodes[ci], from, to)) stack[sp++] = ci;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    val_t c = v.dot(normal) / vNorm;\n    return (ZERO < c) ? c : ZERO;  // std::max(ZERO, c)\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 pointInTriangle(const float4& a, const float4& e1, const float4& e2,\n                                                val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 A(a.x, a.y, a.z), ab(e1.x, e1.y, e1.z), ac(e2.x, e2.y, e2.z);\n    return A + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\nstruct FFParams {\n    uint64_t numPairs;          // pairs in this batch = nb * N\n    uint32_t nb;                // rows in batch\n    uint32_t b0;                // first local row of the batch\n    uint32_t nloc;              // local rows of this rank\n    uint32_t N;\n    uint32_t i0;                // global index of first local row\n    uint32_t maskWords;         // 32-bit mask words per row\n    uint64_t bufBase;           // global draw index of buf[0]\n};\n\n// One thread per (pair, ray); 16 consecutive lanes form one pair.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(256)\nformFactorKernel(FFParams P,\n                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ maskBits, const uint32_t* __restrict__ maskPrefix,\n                 const uint64_t* __restrict__ rowOff, const uint32_t* __restrict__ buf,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ triA, const float4* __restrict__ triE1,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ triE2, const float4* __restrict__ triN,\n                 const float* __restrict__ areas,\n                 const DevNode* __restrict__ nodes, const float4* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                 float* __restrict__ W, unsigned long long* __restrict__ nonZeroCount) {\n    const uint64_t gid = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int ray = static_cast<int>(gid & (NUM_RAYS - 1));\n    const uint64_t p = gid / NUM_RAYS;\n\n    bool active = p < P.numPairs;\n    uint32_t iloc = 0, j = 0, i = 0;\n    val_t contrib = ZERO;\n    if (active) {\n        iloc = P.b0 + static_cast<uint32_t>(p % P.nb);\n        j = static_cast<uint32_t>(p / P.nb);\n        i = P.i0 + iloc;\n        const size_t mw = static_cast<size_t>(iloc) * P.maskWords + (j >> 5);\n        const uint32_t word = maskBits[mw];\n        const uint32_t bit = 1u << (j & 31);\n        active = (word & bit) != 0;   // i != j and not culled\n        if (active) {\n            const uint64_t r = rowOff[iloc] + maskPrefix[mw] + __popc(word & (bit - 1));\n            const uint32_t* d = buf + (r * DRAWS_PER_PAIR + 4 * ray - P.bufBase);\n            const uint4 dr = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(d);\n            const float4 aI = __ldg(triA + i), e1I = __ldg(triE1 + i), e2I = __ldg(triE2 + i);\n            const float4 aJ = __ldg(triA + j), e1J = __ldg(triE1 + j), e2J = __ldg(triE2 + j);\n            Vec3 pI = pointInTriangle(aI, e1I, e2I, drawToFloat(dr.x), drawToFloat(dr.y));\n            Vec3 pJ = pointInTriangle(aJ, e1J, e2J, drawToFloat(dr.z), drawToFloat(dr.w));\n\n            if (!isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, leafTris, static_cast<int>(i), static_cast<int>(j))) {\n                Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n                val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n                if (!(distSqr < EPSILON)) {\n                    const float4 nI = __ldg(triN + i), nJ = __ldg(triN + j);\n                    val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, Vec3(nI.x, nI.y, nI.z));\n                    val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, Vec3(nJ.x, nJ.y, nJ.z));\n                    if (!(cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO))\n                        contrib = (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Sequential accumulation over rays in the original order\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) kij += __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, contrib, r, NUM_RAYS);\n    kij = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n\n    const bool leader = active && ray == 0;\n    if (leader && kij > ZERO) {\n        val_t w = kij * areas[j];\n        W[static_cast<size_t>(j) * P.nloc + iloc] = (ONE < w) ? ONE : w;  // std::min(kij * area_j, 1)\n    }\n    const unsigned ballot = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, leader && kij > EPSILON);\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0 && ballot) atomicAdd(nonZeroCount, static_cast<unsigned long long>(__popc(ballot)));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Kernel (one timestep, one thread per local receiver triangle)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void simulateStepKernel(uint32_t t, uint32_t N, uint32_t nloc, uint32_t i0,\n                                   const float* __restrict__ W, const uint16_t* __restrict__ tau,\n                                   float* __restrict__ radB, val_t rho, uint32_t sourceIndex,\n                                   uint32_t timeOff) {\n    const uint32_t iloc = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (iloc >= nloc) return;\n    const uint32_t i = i0 + iloc;\n    const int ti = static_cast<int>(t);\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        const size_t e = static_cast<size_t>(j) * nloc + iloc;\n        const int tauij = tau[e];\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (ti < tauij) continue;\n        const val_t w = W[e];  // min(kij * area_j, 1), zero where kij <= 0 or i == j\n        if (!(w > ZERO)) continue;\n        const val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(ti - tauij) * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n        sumB += w * radJ;\n    }\n    const val_t radE = (i == sourceIndex && t < timeOff) ? 1.0f : ZERO;\n    radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i] = rho * sumB + radE;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix), replicated on all ranks\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n    FlatOctree flat;                // GPU copy of the octree\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n    size_t timeOff;                 // Source emits for t < timeOff\n\n    // Row decomposition over MPI ranks\n    size_t i0, i1, nloc;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts, rowDispls;\n\n    unsigned long long nonZeroKij = 0;   // global count of Kij > EPSILON\n\n    // Device data\n    float* dW = nullptr;            // min(kij*area_j, 1) (N x nloc, transposed)\n    uint16_t* dTau = nullptr;       // tau (N x nloc, transposed)\n    float* dRadB = nullptr;         // T x N\n\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n    state.flat.flatten(state.octree, state.triangles);\n    if (static_cast<int>(state.flat.maxDepth) * 7 + 1 > OCTREE_STACK) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for GPU traversal stack\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(N, reflectivity);\n\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(N, ZERO);\n\n    // Source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    state.timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n\n    // Block row decomposition\n    state.rowCounts.resize(g_size);\n    state.rowDispls.resize(g_size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        size_t a = N * static_cast<size_t>(r) / g_size;\n        size_t b = N * static_cast<size_t>(r + 1) / g_size;\n        state.rowDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(a);\n        state.rowCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(b - a);\n    }\n    state.i0 = state.rowDispls[g_rank];\n    state.nloc = state.rowCounts[g_rank];\n    state.i1 = state.i0 + state.nloc;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles, nloc = state.nloc, i0 = state.i0;\n\n    std::vector<Vec3> centers(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) centers[i] = state.triangles[i].center();\n\n    std::vector<uint16_t> tau(N * nloc, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        for (size_t il = 0; il < nloc; ++il) {\n            size_t i = i0 + il;\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            val_t dist = (centers[i] - centers[j]).norm();\n            int tv = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n            tau[j * nloc + il] = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::min(tv, 65535));\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTau, std::max<size_t>(1, N * nloc) * sizeof(uint16_t)));\n    if (nloc) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTau, tau.data(), N * nloc * sizeof(uint16_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles, nloc = state.nloc, i0 = state.i0;\n    const size_t MW = (N + 31) / 32;\n\n    // --- Culling masks: bit (i, j) set iff i != j and the pair is not culled (consumes RNG draws)\n    std::vector<uint32_t> maskBits(nloc * MW, 0), maskPrefix(nloc * MW, 0);\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowCnt(nloc, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)\n    for (size_t il = 0; il < nloc; ++il) {\n        const size_t i = i0 + il;\n        const Vec3 nI = state.triangles[i].normal();\n        uint32_t* bits = &maskBits[il * MW];\n        uint32_t* pre = &maskPrefix[il * MW];\n        uint64_t cnt = 0;\n        for (size_t w = 0; w < MW; ++w) {\n            uint32_t word = 0;\n            for (size_t b = 0; b < 32; ++b) {\n                size_t j = w * 32 + b;\n                if (j >= N || j == i) continue;\n                // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n                if (nI.dot(state.triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) continue;\n                word |= 1u << b;\n            }\n            bits[w] = word;\n            pre[w] = static_cast<uint32_t>(cnt);\n            cnt += static_cast<uint64_t>(__builtin_popcount(word));\n        }\n        rowCnt[il] = cnt;\n    }\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowOff(nloc + 1, 0);\n    uint64_t localPairs = 0;\n    for (size_t il = 0; il < nloc; ++il) localPairs += rowCnt[il];\n    uint64_t pairBase = 0;\n    MPI_Exscan(&localPairs, &pairBase, 1, MPI_UINT64_T, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (g_rank == 0) pairBase = 0;\n    rowOff[0] = pairBase;\n    for (size_t il = 0; il < nloc; ++il) rowOff[il + 1] = rowOff[il] + rowCnt[il];\n\n    // --- MT19937 stream decomposition: chunk k of this rank starts at draw D0 + k*S\n    const uint64_t D0 = pairBase * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n    const uint64_t totalDraws = localPairs * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n    const uint64_t S = static_cast<uint64_t>(mtj::MT_N) * 256;\n    const uint64_t K = (totalDraws + S - 1) / S;\n    const uint64_t G = std::max<uint64_t>(1, std::min<uint64_t>(64, static_cast<uint64_t>(std::ceil(std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(K))))));\n    const uint64_t numGroups = (K + G - 1) / G;\n\n    std::vector<mtj::State> groupStart(numGroups);\n    std::vector<mtj::Poly> stepPoly(G);  // x^(m*S) mod phi, m = 0..G-1\n    if (K > 0) {\n        mtj::Field field;\n        mtj::Poly polyD0, polyGS;\n        const int numTasks = static_cast<int>(G) + 1;\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n        for (int task = 0; task < numTasks; ++task) {\n            if (task == 0) polyD0 = field.powX(D0);\n            else if (task == 1) { if (numGroups > 1) polyGS = field.powX(G * S); }\n            else stepPoly[task - 1] = field.powX(static_cast<uint64_t>(task - 1) * S);\n        }\n        groupStart[0] = mtj::Field::jump(polyD0, mtj::seedState(42));\n        for (uint64_t g = 1; g < numGroups; ++g) groupStart[g] = mtj::Field::jump(polyGS, groupStart[g - 1]);\n    }\n\n    // --- Device data\n    const size_t numNodes = state.flat.nodes.size();\n    std::vector<float4> hA(N), hE1(N), hE2(N), hN(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        Vec3 e1 = t.b - t.a, e2 = t.c - t.a, n = t.normal();\n        hA[i] = make_float4(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z, 0.0f);\n        hE1[i] = make_float4(e1.x, e1.y, e1.z, 0.0f);\n        hE2[i] = make_float4(e2.x, e2.y, e2.z, 0.0f);\n        hN[i] = make_float4(n.x, n.y, n.z, 0.0f);\n    }\n    float4 *dA, *dE1, *dE2, *dN, *dLeaf;\n    float* dArea;\n    DevNode* dNodes;\n    uint32_t *dBits, *dPrefix, *dBuf = nullptr, *dStates = nullptr;\n    uint64_t* dRowOff;\n    unsigned long long* dCount;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, N * sizeof(float4)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dE1, N * sizeof(float4)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dE2, N * sizeof(float4)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dN, N * sizeof(float4)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dArea, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dNodes, numNodes * sizeof(DevNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLeaf, std::max<size_t>(1, state.flat.leafTris.size()) * sizeof(float4)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dBits, std::max<size_t>(1, nloc * MW) * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPrefix, std::max<size_t>(1, nloc * MW) * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dRowOff, (nloc + 1) * sizeof(uint64_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dCount, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dW, std::max<size_t>(1, N * nloc) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dA, hA.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dE1, hE1.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dE2, hE2.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dN, hN.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dArea, state.areas.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dNodes, state.flat.nodes.data(), numNodes * sizeof(DevNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!state.flat.leafTris.empty())\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dLeaf, state.flat.leafTris.data(), state.flat.leafTris.size() * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (nloc) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dBits, maskBits.data(), nloc * MW * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPrefix, maskPrefix.data(), nloc * MW * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dRowOff, rowOff.data(), (nloc + 1) * sizeof(uint64_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dCount, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dW, 0, std::max<size_t>(1, N * nloc) * sizeof(float)));\n\n    // --- Row batches limited by the size of the random draw buffer\n    const uint64_t maxBatchDraws = 1ull << 27;\n    struct Batch { size_t b0, b1; uint64_t kA, kB; };\n    std::vector<Batch> batches;\n    uint64_t maxChunks = 0;\n    for (size_t b0 = 0; b0 < nloc;) {\n        size_t b1 = b0 + 1;\n        while (b1 < nloc && (rowOff[b1 + 1] - rowOff[b0]) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR <= maxBatchDraws) ++b1;\n        Batch bt{b0, b1, 0, 0};\n        uint64_t dA_ = (rowOff[b0] - pairBase) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n        uint64_t dB_ = (rowOff[b1] - pairBase) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n        bt.kA = dA_ / S;\n        bt.kB = (dB_ + S - 1) / S;\n        if (bt.kB < bt.kA) bt.kB = bt.kA;\n        maxChunks = std::max(maxChunks, bt.kB - bt.kA);\n        batches.push_back(bt);\n        b0 = b1;\n    }\n    if (maxChunks > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dBuf, maxChunks * S * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dStates, maxChunks * mtj::MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    }\n\n    auto computeStates = [&](const Batch& bt, std::vector<uint32_t>& out) {\n        const uint64_t nc = bt.kB - bt.kA;\n        out.resize(nc * mtj::MT_N);\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n        for (uint64_t c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n            const uint64_t k = bt.kA + c;\n            const uint64_t g = k / G, m = k % G;\n            mtj::State s = (m == 0) ? groupStart[g] : mtj::Field::jump(stepPoly[m], groupStart[g]);\n            memcpy(&out[c * mtj::MT_N], s.data(), mtj::MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t));\n        }\n    };\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> curStates, nextStates;\n    if (!batches.empty()) computeStates(batches[0], curStates);\n    for (size_t bi = 0; bi < batches.size(); ++bi) {\n        const Batch& bt = batches[bi];\n        const uint64_t nc = bt.kB - bt.kA;\n        if (nc > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dStates, curStates.data(), nc * mtj::MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            mtGenerateKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(nc), MT_THREADS>>>(dStates, dBuf, S);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n            FFParams P;\n            P.nb = static_cast<uint32_t>(bt.b1 - bt.b0);\n            P.numPairs = static_cast<uint64_t>(P.nb) * N;\n            P.b0 = static_cast<uint32_t>(bt.b0);\n            P.nloc = static_cast<uint32_t>(nloc);\n            P.N = static_cast<uint32_t>(N);\n            P.i0 = static_cast<uint32_t>(i0);\n            P.maskWords = static_cast<uint32_t>(MW);\n            P.bufBase = D0 + bt.kA * S;\n            const uint64_t threads = P.numPairs * NUM_RAYS;\n            const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((threads + 255) / 256);\n            formFactorKernel<<<blocks, 256>>>(P, dBits, dPrefix, dRowOff, dBuf, dA, dE1, dE2, dN, dArea,\n                                              dNodes, dLeaf, state.dW, dCount);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n        // Overlap: prepare the next batch's generator states while the GPU works\n
